rest.short: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, MQTT, SOAP and MCP
rest.text: REST, GraphQL with a schema browser, gRPC through reflection or .proto files, WebSocket, Socket.IO, MQTT, SignalR, Server-Sent Events, SOAP, MCP, and on the desktop raw TCP, UDP and NATS, in one window.

oauth.short: OAuth 2, AWS SigV4, NTLM, Digest and more
oauth.text: Basic, bearer, API key, OAuth 1 and 2 with renewal, Digest, AWS SigV4, NTLM, Akamai EdgeGrid, JWT, ASAP and Hawk.

network.short: Multipart, files, cookies, proxies, client certificates
network.text: JSON, XML, form, multipart and file bodies, a cookie jar, proxy and client certificates, and curl commands pasted straight into a request.

response-viewer.short: Previews, timing, and code in 21 languages
response-viewer.text: JSON tree, HTML, image and PDF previews, headers, cookies, size and timing. Download any body, including binary, or copy it as code in 21 targets, including cURL, Python, Go, Java, C#, Swift, Rust and wget.

scopes.short: Five scopes, secrets in your keychain
scopes.text: Secret variables in your OS keychain, plus global, collection, folder and request scopes, dynamic variables and prompts.

secret-managers.text: Pull values from Vault, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, 1Password, Bitwarden or KeePassXC at send time.

runner.short: Data files, schedules, JUnit and HTML reports
runner.text: CSV, JSON and XLSX data, snapshot checks, scheduled runs, parallel runs, HTML and JUnit reports, and a CLI that exits non-zero on failure.

mock.short: Serve examples or an OpenAPI spec locally
mock.text: Serve saved examples or an OpenAPI spec locally, with rules and a live request log.

git-panel.text: Diff, commit, push, branches, stash and conflict resolution, in the desktop app.

folder-workspace.short: Collections as YAML in your repo
folder-workspace.text: Nested collections, tabs and history, kept as plain YAML files in a folder or in app storage.

import.short: Postman, Bruno, Insomnia, OpenAPI and 11 more
import.text: Import Postman, OpenAPI, Insomnia, HAR, WSDL, Bruno, Hoppscotch, Thunder Client, HTTPie, Hurl, Firecamp, RAML, API Blueprint, .http files and curl commands. Export to Postman, OpenAPI, Markdown, .http files or a backup.

agents.short: An MCP server that redacts secrets
agents.text: An MCP server with secret redaction and a host allowlist, and a web version with nothing to install.
